run_parallel_with_progressbar: run a function in parallel across multiple jobs using ParallelTqdm with a tqdm progress bar
run_joblib_map_sequential: run a function over an iterable sequentially with a tqdm progress bar using joblib_map
run_joblib_map_loky: run a function in parallel using the loky backend with progress tracking via joblib_map
review_paralleltqdm_class: review the ParallelTqdm class that extends joblib.Parallel to add tqdm progress bar support
refactor_joblib_map_backend: refactor joblib_map to switch between sequential, loky, threading, or multiprocessing backends
